content: Corojo Label is a premium, hand-crafted cigar brand owned by Cigar.com, Inc. The creation of this proprietary brand began in 2004, spearheaded by the company's in-house blending team. In early 2006, the company collaborated with renowned cigar maker Pepin Garcia and his son, Jaime Garcia, to finalize the desired blend. The result of this collaboration was introduced to the market in late February 2007. These cigars are produced in Estelí, Nicaragua, at the Tabacalera Cubana (TACUBA) factory. Corojo Label is part of a series of House Blends developed by Cigar.com and manufactured by various producers specifically for the company. The cigars are full-bodied, featuring a Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper, a Honduran binder, and Nicaraguan filler tobaccos. They are presented in cellophane and packaged in slide-top, cabinet-style boxes containing 20 cigars each.
